resources.string: Locke uses this to notice when you open an app, or browse to a website, you\'ve chosen to block, so it can show your habit checklist until you\'ve completed today\'s habits (or keep it blocked outright, for lists you\'ve set to never unlock).
Do your habits.\nThen use your apps.
Locke locks the apps that distract you most and only unlocks them once you\'ve finished your habits for the day.
Pick the apps to lock and the habits that unlock them -- takes about a minute
Habits can be honor-system, or photo-verified by AI so you can\'t fake it
Streaks, a daily lootbox, and a bedtime curfew keep it going after today
Choose the apps you want locked until your habits are done. Nothing locks until you finish setup, and you can add or remove apps anytime from Settings.
No apps selected yet -- that\'s fine, you can lock some later from Settings.
Pick the habits that unlock your apps. Check at least one to continue -- you can edit, add, or remove habits anytime later.

Every habit you pick here gates your locked apps: miss it today and those apps stay locked. Want a habit that\'s just tracked, or an antihabit, or one verified by a proof photo? Add those later from Settings -- these five are just a quick start.

Locke needs a few permissions to lock apps and check your progress. All three are optional here -- skip any of them and finish setup anyway, then grant them later from Settings whenever you\'re ready. Until they\'re granted, Locke simply won\'t lock anything.

Photo verification (add an Anthropic API key in Settings), a hard bedtime curfew, antihabits you pay a time penalty for slipping on, and the daily lootbox that hands out grace tokens and skip tokens -- all live in Settings, ready whenever you want them.
Lets Locke see which app is currently open, so it knows when to show the lock screen.
Lets Locke detect the moment you switch into a blocked app.
Lets Locke show the lock screen on top of a blocked app.
Reminds you about unfinished habits and streak milestones.

Finish these habits to unlock this site for the rest of today.
Blocked by your \"%1$s\" list -- no habit or grace token unlocks it.
